description: A hook killed by a signal that is not its timeout's is logged as a non-zero exit with status 128 + the signal number (KILL: 137); the next hook runs.

expect.log:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 (hook_pre_killed.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 exited non-zero [ 137 ]; continuing

[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 (hook_pre_ok.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 completed
expect.errors: [ pfB Hook ] pre #0 exited non-zero [ 137 ]; continuing
expect.transcript:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 (hook_pre_killed.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 exited non-zero [ 137 ]; continuing

[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 (hook_pre_ok.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 completed
